intro: Please send your reply as soon as you know — it helps us plan the menu, seating and every last detail. Replies appear in our planner the moment they are sent.
footer: We cannot wait to celebrate with you

form.contactHint: Give us at least one of the two so we can confirm the details.
form.declineNote: We will miss you, but thank you for telling us.
form.peopleHint: Add everyone who is coming with you, then pick a meal for each person.
form.messagePlaceholder: Anything you would like us to know
form.privacy: Your details are only visible to the two of us.

errors.contactRequired: Add an email address or a phone number so we can reach you.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address does not look right.
errors.attendanceRequired: Please let us know whether you can join us.
errors.personNameRequired: Please give a name for everyone who is coming.
errors.mealRequired: Please choose a meal for every person.
errors.saveFailed: We could not save your reply. Please try again in a moment, or send us a message directly.
errors.networkFailed: We could not reach the RSVP service. Check your connection and try again.

success.attendingBody: Your reply is with us. We cannot wait to celebrate with you at {venue} on {date}.
success.declinedBody: We are sorry you cannot make it, but thank you for letting us know. You will be missed.
success.next: Plans changed? Send another reply or get in touch with us directly and we will update your place.
